status_at_registration: Candidate implementation and correctness fixtures only; no candidate performance results examined.
hypothesis: Prefer a cycle already exposed by a received token to further exploration; score alternative closures by observed gross debt reduction.
baseline: Unchanged exponent-four Numbat with snapshot capacities and close_first=false.
control: Existing Numbat close_first=true; weighted ordering among closures.
candidate: ImprovedNumbat: choose largest length times observed bottleneck; tie by shorter length then neighbor ID; unchanged exploration and settlement.
split_policy: Evaluate every fixed method on both splits regardless of development results. No tuning, selection or early stopping based on scores. Old MDG2 seeds0-2 are diagnostic evidence, not heldout.
generator: Same construction as original MDG2: directed ring plus seeded random arcs, no self/opposite arcs; sorted arc weights uniformly1..100. Algorithm and generator use the same seed, as in the original comparison.
ordering: Development then heldout; repeat-major; rotate method order by case index and repeat; sequential timing with no concurrent performance workers.
primary_endpoint: Summed debt removed over unique heldout graphs divided by summed baseline debt removed. Timing repeats are not additional graph samples.
promotion_rule: For each alternative independently: at least5% more pooled heldout clearing, at most25% more pooled messages, JSON bytes and sum of per-graph median runtimes; no family loses more than5% of baseline clearing; every ledger passes replay, original-capacity bounds, net-position conservation and complete drain.
reporting: Publish all methods, both splits and every family, including failures. Report certified maximum cancellation and fractions of it separately from fractions of initial gross debt. Do not claim universal optimality or production improvement.
oracle: Unmodified informalsystems/cycles-overview32dc873c45041accb365e73a8ef35bee10a80f1d, default NetworkX3.5 max_flow_min_cost; independently certify each optimum. Oracle is outside actor decisions.
limits: Synthetic static ledgers only; no new credit, arrivals, losses, crashes or malicious actors.
Path-bearing tokens disclose remote identities and capacity hints; not the private app protocol.
Single-process event simulator, debtor-owned balances, staged commits; audit conservation after drain.
Actual compact JSON application envelopes; excludes network headers and ledger distribution. Cycles transport is not implemented, so comparison overhead is N/A.
Same finite horizon and soft message admission cutoff plus drain; no guarantee of exhausting clearable opportunities.
Shared seeded scheduler RNG couples routing draws and delivery schedules; matched seeds are not identical delivery traces.
